sql_dtl_ctn: SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE , SEGMENT1 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE 1=1 AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ALL_V_TYPE' AND SEGMENT1 <> 'ALL'
SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE , SEGMENT1 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE 1=1 AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ALL_Y_TYPE' AND SEGMENT1 <> 'ALL'
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE (LOOKUP_TYPE = 'APPLICATION') ORDER BY UPPER(SEGMENT1)

SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, SEGMENT1 AS NAME FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND (NVL(TRIM(@param1 || @divisionId), '-') = '-' OR SEGMENT3 = TRIM(@param1 || @divisionId)) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT *
  FROM (
WITH WT_AS_SITE AS (
	SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(A.SEGMENT1) >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS AS_SITE_YN
	  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
	 WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT'
	   AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
	   AND SEGMENT3 = @division
	   AND SEGMENT1 = @salesSite
)
SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
 wHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_INCOTERMS'
   AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND SEGMENT1 = @division
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                 FROM WT_AS_SITE B
                WHERE B.AS_SITE_YN = 'Y'
              )
 UNION 
   ALL
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
 WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INCOTERMS'
   AND VALID_YN = 'Y' --[PJ20228272] NERP 대응 - INCOTERMS Valid 추가
   AND ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                 FROM WT_AS_SITE B
                WHERE B.AS_SITE_YN = 'N'
              )
       )
 ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ
        , UPPER(CODE)

SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME , A.ATTRIBUTE4 AS LINK_UI_TYPE , A.ATTRIBUTE5 AS PROGRAM_NAME , A.ATTRIBUTE6 AS CONFIRM_YN , A.ATTRIBUTE7 AS AUTO_YN , A.ATTRIBUTE8 AS OPTION_YN FROM ( SELECT * FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPMZ_ACTV_CD' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)

SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME , A.ATTRIBUTE4 AS LINK_UI_TYPE , A.ATTRIBUTE5 AS PROGRAM_NAME , A.ATTRIBUTE6 AS CONFIRM_YN , A.ATTRIBUTE7 AS AUTO_YN , A.ATTRIBUTE8 AS OPTION_YN FROM ( SELECT * FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPMZ_ACTV_CD' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M UG JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL AG ON AG.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP' AND AG.SEGMENT2 = 'SCP0120' AND AG.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND AG.SEGMENT1 = UG.USER_GR_ID WHERE UG.USER_ID = @sesUserId) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CODE, 'ADMIN_YN' AS NAME FROM DUAL
SELECT DIVISION_ID AS CODE, DIVISION_ID || ' ' || MIN(DIVISION_NAME) AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID ORDER BY UPPER(DIVISION_ID)

SELECT DISTINCT P.DIVISION_ID ,P.ITEM_ID ,P.PLANT_SITE_ID ,S.SITE_DESCRIPTION ,LS.LINE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY P JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON P.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND S.OPERATION_GROUP=@operationGroup AND P.PLANT_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID JOIN SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS ON LS.COMPANY_ID = S.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID = S.PLANT_ID AND LS.SITE_ID = S.SITE_ID AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY UPPER(P.ITEM_ID), UPPER(P.PLANT_SITE_ID), UPPER(LS.LINE_ID)

SELECT TO_CHAR(JIG_ITEM_SEQ) JIG_ITEM_SEQ , TO_CHAR(JIG_SEQ) JIG_SEQ , ITEM_ID , TO_CHAR(fn_char_to_date(FROM_YYYYMMDD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM_YYYYMMDD , TO_CHAR(fn_char_to_date(TO_YYYYMMDD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') TO_YYYYMMDD , VALID_YN , '-' ACTION_FLAG_DIV FROM SCP_MST_JIG_ITEM

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , (A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || B.SITE_DESCRIPTION) SITE_DESCRIPTION , A.SCM_SITE_ID , A.OPERATION_ID , B.OPERATION_GROUP , L.SEGMENT2 OPERATION_GROUP_NM , A.JIG_NAME , A.JIG_SEQ , '-' ACTION_FLAG_DIV FROM SCP_MST_JIG A JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE='OPERATION_GROUP' AND L.VALID_YN='Y' AND L.SEGMENT1=B.OPERATION_GROUP

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND OPERATION_GROUP = @operationGroup AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND OSP_YN = 'N' ORDER BY UPPER(OSP_YN), UPPER(SCM_SITE_ID)
SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1=1 AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
SELECT SCM_SITE_ID CODE , SITE_DESCRIPTION NAME , OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_MST_SITE WHERE 1=1 AND VALID_YN = 'Y'

SELECT  DISTINCT API_ID CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.API_MSG_DESC) ||'('||T1.API_ID||')' NAME 
      FROM  SCM_ADM_API_M T1
 LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG
        ON  T1.API_MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID 
       AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd
  ORDER BY  UPPER(NAME)

SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.DESCRIPTION) NAME
     FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1
LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG
       ON  T1.SEGMENT2 = MSG.MSG_ID 
      AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd
    WHERE  1=1
      AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'API_TP_CD'
      AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'
 ORDER BY  UPPER(T1.LOOKUP_TYPE), T1.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_INCOTERMS'
  AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
ORDER BY UPPER(SEGMENT2)

SELECT SOLDTO_CODE AS CODE, SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_CUSTOMER WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND SOLDTO_CODE IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A WHERE UPPR_UNIT_ID = @divisionId AND USER_GR_ID = @__GROUP__ AND USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'C') ORDER BY UPPER(SOLDTO_CODE)

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
                          WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP'
                            AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                            AND L.SEGMENT2 = 'ALL'
                            AND L.SEGMENT1 = @__GROUP__)
            THEN 'ADMIN'
            ELSE NVL(U.DEPT_ID, ' ')
       END AS CODE
     , CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
                          WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP'
                            AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                            AND L.SEGMENT2 = 'ALL'
                            AND L.SEGMENT1 = @__GROUP__)
            THEN 'ADMIN'
            ELSE NVL(U.DEPT_ID, ' ')
       END AS NAME
  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U
 WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId

SELECT S.PLANT_ID AS CODE , S.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND S.PLANT_ID IS NOT NULL AND S.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND S.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT U.UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND U.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT G.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) ) AND S.PLANT_ID IN ( SELECT U.UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'P' AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND U.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT G.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || U.UPPR_UNIT_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY UPPER(S.PLANT_ID)
select SEGMENT1 as code , SEGMENT2 as name from SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL where LOOKUP_TYPE ='BIZ_TYPE_BPMS' order by DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT * FROM( SELECT distinct a.division_id ,b.from_site ,SF.SITE_TYPE AS FROM_SITE_TYPE ,b.to_site ,ST.SITE_TYPE AS TO_SITE_TYPE ,a.item_id FROM scp_mst_bod_item a INNER JOIN scp_mst_bod b ON a.bod_id = b.bod_id INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE SF ON SF.SCM_SITE_ID=b.from_site and sf.SITE_TYPE='PLANT' and sf.operation_group=@operationGroup INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE ST ON ST.SCM_SITE_ID=b.to_site ) a WHERE 1=1 and ( @divisionId IN (SELECT division_id FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE attribute3 = 'EE') OR a.division_id = @divisionId ) ORDER BY UPPER(a.division_id), UPPER(a.item_id)

SELECT DISTINCT a.ITEM_ID CODE ,a.ITEM_ID NAME FROM scp_mst_bod_item a INNER JOIN scp_mst_bod b ON a.bod_id = b.bod_id AND B.incoterms='DAP' INNER JOIN scm_mst_site sf on sf.scm_site_id=b.from_site and sf.valid_yn='Y' and sf.operation_group=@operationGroup INNER JOIN scm_mst_site st on st.scm_site_id=b.TO_SITE and st.valid_yn='Y' and st.SITE_TYPE='PLANT' WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY P WHERE P.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND P.PLANT_SITE_ID=B.FROM_SITE AND P.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID AND P.VALID_YN='Y') order by UPPER(item_id)

SELECT * FROM( SELECT distinct a.item_id as code ,a.item_id as name ,a.division_id ,a.item_id ,sf.DIVISION_ID as FROM_DIVISION_ID ,st.division_id as TO_DIVISION_ID FROM scp_mst_bod_item a INNER JOIN scp_mst_bod b ON a.bod_id = b.bod_id INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE SF ON SF.SCM_SITE_ID=b.from_site and sf.SITE_TYPE='PLANT' and sf.operation_group=( @operationGroup ) and ( ( @divisionId ) IS NULL OR ( @divisionId ) IN (SELECT division_id FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE attribute3 = 'EE') OR sf.DIVISION_ID=( @divisionId ) ) INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE ST ON ST.SCM_SITE_ID=b.to_site and ( ( @siteType ) IS NULL OR ST.SITE_TYPE=( @siteType ) ) and ( ( @divisionId ) IS NULL OR ( @divisionId ) IN (SELECT division_id FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE attribute3 = 'EE') OR ST.DIVISION_ID=( @divisionId ) ) ) a WHERE 1=1 and ( ( @divisionId ) IN (SELECT division_id FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE attribute3 = 'EE') OR a.division_id = ( @divisionId ) ) ORDER BY UPPER(a.division_id), UPPER(a.item_id)

SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE
     , SEGMENT2 AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BUCKET_TYPE_CODE'
ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT M.USER_GR_ID AS CODE, M.USER_GR_ID AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M M
WHERE M.USER_ID = @sesUserId
  AND M.USE_YN = 'Y'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
              WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                AND L.SEGMENT1 = M.USER_GR_ID AND L.SEGMENT2 = 'ALL')
ORDER BY DECODE(M.USER_GR_ID, 'ADMIN', 1, 2), UPPER(M.USER_GR_ID)

SELECT '40' AS DIVISION_ID , L.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , L.SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE 1 = 1 AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_BIZ_TYPE' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT P.DIVISION_ID , P.BIZ_TYPE AS CODE , P.BIZ_TYPE_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT P WHERE TRIM(P.BIZ_TYPE_NAME) IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT BIZ_TYPE AS CODE, BIZ_TYPE_NAME AS NAME
FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT
WHERE TRIM(BIZ_TYPE_NAME) IS NOT NULL
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)
ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)

SELECT *
  FROM (
SELECT '40' AS DIVISION_ID, L.SEGMENT1 AS CODE, L.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_BIZ_TYPE'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT P.DIVISION_ID, P.BIZ_TYPE AS CODE, P.BIZ_TYPE_NAME AS NAME
FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT P
WHERE TRIM(P.BIZ_TYPE_NAME) IS NOT NULL
       )
 ORDER BY UPPER(DIVISION_ID)
        , UPPER(CODE)
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE , SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BOD_TYPE_CODE' ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.DESCRIPTION) NAME
     FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1
LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG
       ON  T1.SEGMENT2 = MSG.MSG_ID 
      AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd
    WHERE  1=1
      AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BTN_TP_CD'
      AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'
 ORDER BY  UPPER(T1.LOOKUP_TYPE), T1.DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT L.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , L.SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BUCKET_TYPE_CODE_ISO' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT SEGMENT1  AS CODE      , SEGMENT2  AS NAME FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE  1 = 1 AND    LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BUCKET_TYPE_CODE' ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT SEGMENT1  AS CODE
      , SEGMENT2  AS NAME
FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE  1 = 1
AND    LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BUCKET2_TYPE_CODE'
AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 )
SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 )
SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME ,PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT IA.CODE , IA.NAME FROM (SELECT 'ALL' AS CODE , 'ALL' AS NAME , 0 AS SORT_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_ID || ' : ' || A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME , 1 AS SORT_NO FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND (@pPlantSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || SUBSTR(@pPlantSiteId, 1, 4) || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0) AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)) IA ORDER BY IA.SORT_NO , UPPER(IA.CODE)

SELECT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(A.ACTIVE_FLAG,'N') = 'Y' GROUP BY A.FACTORY_ID , A.FACTORY_NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.PLANT_ID

SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(A.ACTIVE_FLAG,'N') = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param3 IS NULL OR A.SHOP_GROUP_ID IN ( SELECT CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(@param3, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) = 'F' THEN 'A' ELSE REGEXP_SUBSTR(@param3, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) end FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(@param3, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL ) )

SELECT DISTINCT F.FACTORY_NAME AS CODE , F.FACTORY_ID AS NAME , F.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID , F.PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID , F.COMPANY_ID AS COMPANY_ID , S.SCM_SITE_ID AS SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN F JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON S.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID AND S.PLANT_ID = F.PLANT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || F.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || F.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 )
SELECT DISTINCT CALENDAR_YYYY AS CODE, CALENDAR_YYYY AS NAME FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M ORDER BY UPPER(CALENDAR_YYYY)
SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY AS CODE, CALENDAR_YYYY AS NAME FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M GROUP BY CALENDAR_YYYY
SELECT SEGMENT1 as code , SEGMENT2 as name FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE' ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT NVL(G.CELL_GROUP, '') CODE , NVL(G.CELL_GROUP, '') AS NAME FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_TG G , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F WHERE 0 = 0 AND G.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' AND G.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND G.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID AND G.CELL_ITEM_ID = F.ITEM_ID AND G.CELL_GROUP IS NOT NULL ORDER BY NVL(G.CELL_GROUP, '') DESC

SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE' AND SEGMENT1 = '-' AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN I
                   WHERE I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL'
                     AND I.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND I.ITEM_ID = @itemId
                     AND @itemId IS NOT NULL AND @itemId <> 'ALL')
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT S.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, M.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
FROM SCM_MST_SITE S
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.COMPANY_ID, I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
        FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN I
       WHERE I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL
         AND I.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL'
         AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR I.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId)
         AND (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId = 'ALL' OR I.ITEM_ID = @itemId)) SS
  ON S.DIVISION_ID = SS.DIVISION_ID AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = SS.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
 AND S.COMPANY_ID = SS.COMPANY_ID
JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
  ON M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE' AND M.SEGMENT1 = S.SCM_SITE_ID AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
WHERE S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' AND S.OSP_YN = 'N'
  AND ( @divisionId IS NULL
        OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                      FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN I2
                     WHERE I2.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId
                       AND I2.ITEM_ID = @itemId
                       AND I2.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                       AND I2.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL' ) )

SELECT X.CODE , X.NAME FROM ( SELECT '-' AS CODE , 'Common' AS NAME , 1 AS SORT_NO FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN T1 WHERE T1.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND T1.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND T1.ITEM_ID = @itemId AND T1.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL' ) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT T.PLANT_SITE_ID AS CODE , M.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME , 2 AS SORT_NO FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY T JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID , DIVISION_ID , SITE_ID , SITE_TYPE , SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE WHERE 1 = 1 AND OPERATION_GROUP <> 'W' ) S ON T.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND T.PLANT_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.FLOW_ID AS OPERATION_ID , B.OPERATION_GROUP_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN A JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID , DIVISION_ID , SITE_ID , OPERATION_ID , OPERATION_GROUP_ID FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN ) B ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID,1,5) = B.OPERATION_ID WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND A.FLOW_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND ( @itemId IS NULL OR TRIM(@itemId) = 'ALL' OR A.ITEM_ID = @itemId ) ) C ON S.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID AND S.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID AND S.SITE_ID = C.SITE_ID INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M ON M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE' AND T.PLANT_SITE_ID = M.SEGMENT1 AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y' WHERE S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND T.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN T1 WHERE T1.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND T1.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND T1.ITEM_ID = @itemId AND T1.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL' ) AND ( CASE WHEN @divisionId = '40' THEN '-' ELSE @scmSiteId END IS NULL OR TRIM(CASE WHEN @divisionId = '40' THEN '-' ELSE @scmSiteId END) = 'ALL' OR T.SALES_SITE_ID = CASE WHEN @divisionId = '40' THEN '-' ELSE @scmSiteId END ) AND ( CASE WHEN @divisionId = '40' THEN '-' ELSE @projectCode END IS NULL OR TRIM(CASE WHEN @divisionId = '40' THEN '-' ELSE @projectCode END) = 'ALL' OR T.PROJECT_CODE = CASE WHEN @divisionId = '40' THEN '-' ELSE @projectCode END ) AND ( @itemId IS NULL OR TRIM(@itemId) = 'ALL' OR T.ITEM_ID = @itemId ) ) X ORDER BY X.SORT_NO, UPPER(X.CODE)

SELECT
			SEGMENT2 AS CODE,
			SEGMENT3 AS NAME
		FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL 
		WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_INFO'
			AND SEGMENT1 = '81'

SELECT

SELECT IA.CODE
     , IA.NAME
  FROM (SELECT A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE
             , NVL(C.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C
         WHERE B.DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID
           AND C.SEGMENT1(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.SEGMENT2(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'END_CUSTOMER'
           AND C.VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
           AND NVL(@divisionId, '~') = '40'
         UNION
        SELECT SEGMENT2
             , SEGMENT3
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
           AND SEGMENT1 = '40'
           AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
           AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND NVL(@divisionId, '~') = '40'
         UNION
        SELECT D.END_CUSTOMER
             , NVL(E.SEGMENT3, D.END_CUSTOMER)
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE D
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL E
         WHERE E.SEGMENT1(+) = D.DIVISION_ID
           AND E.SEGMENT2(+) = D.END_CUSTOMER
           AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'END_CUSTOMER'
           AND E.VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
           AND (@deptId IS NULL
                OR @deptId = 'ALL'
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SA
                            WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                              AND SA.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
                              AND INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || SA.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0))
           AND D.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT XA.UNIT_ID
                                   FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M XA
                                  WHERE XA.USER_GR_ID IN (SELECT XB.USER_GR_ID
                                                            FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M XB
                                                           WHERE XB.USER_ID = @sesUserId
                                                             AND XB.USE_YN = 'Y')
                                    AND XA.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
                                    AND XA.USE_YN = 'Y'
                                    AND XA.USER_ID = @sesUserId)
           AND D.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
           AND (@divisionId IS NULL
                OR @divisionId = 'ALL'
                OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || D.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)
           AND NVL(@divisionId, '~') <> '40'
         UNION
        SELECT SEGMENT2
             , NVL(SEGMENT3, SEGMENT2)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE SEGMENT1 IN (SELECT XC.UNIT_ID
                              FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M XC
                             WHERE XC.USER_GR_ID IN (SELECT XD.USER_GR_ID
                                                       FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M XD
                                                      WHERE XD.USER_ID = @sesUserId
                                                        AND XD.USE_YN = 'Y')
                               AND XC.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
                               AND XC.USE_YN = 'Y'
                               AND XC.USER_ID = @sesUserId)
           AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
           AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
           AND SEGMENT1 <> '40'
           AND (@divisionId IS NULL
                OR @divisionId = 'ALL'
                OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || SEGMENT1 || ',') > 0)
           AND (@deptId IS NULL
                OR @deptId = 'ALL')
           AND NVL(@divisionId, '~') <> '40') IA
 ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.CODE, '_-', '/'))
        , UPPER(IA.CODE)

SELECT DISTINCT A.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE
     , NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
  ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1
  AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2
  AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
  AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL'
    OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
  AND ( @deptId IS NULL OR @deptId = 'ALL'
    OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || A.ETL_DEPT_ID || ',') > 0 )
  AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (
    SELECT U.UNIT_ID
    FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
    WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
      AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
      AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId
      AND U.USER_GR_ID IN (
        SELECT G.USER_GR_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
        WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId
          AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) )
  AND A.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY A.END_CUSTOMER

     , CASE NVL((SELECT MAX(U.LANG_CD) FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId), 'KO')

         WHEN 'CN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_CN
         ELSE B.DEPT_NAME_KO END AS NAME
FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
   , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B
WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
  AND A.ETL_DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
  AND A.ETL_DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL'
    OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
  AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (
    SELECT U.UNIT_ID
    FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
    WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
      AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
      AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId
      AND U.USER_GR_ID IN (
        SELECT G.USER_GR_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
        WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId
          AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) )
ORDER BY NAME, CODE

SELECT CODE, NAME
  FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
             , 2 AS SORT_ORDER
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
               LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                      ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                     AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
           AND (NVL(@deptId, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || B.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0)
           AND (NVL(@endCustomer, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || B.PROJECT_CODE || ',') > 0)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT UNIT_ID
                                   FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
                                  WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId)
           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND (A.OPERATION_GROUP IS NULL OR A.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'W')
        UNION ALL
        SELECT B.SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , 1 AS SORT_ORDER
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
               JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B
                 ON A.SEGMENT3 = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SEGMENT1 = B.SCM_SITE_ID
         WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT'
           AND A.SEGMENT3 = '40'
           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND 'Y' = (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
                        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
                       WHERE USER_ID    = @sesUserId
                         AND USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)'
                         AND USE_YN     = 'Y')
       ) RESULTS
 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, UPPER(CODE)

SELECT 'BPS' AS CODE , 'BPS' AS NAME FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'USER' AS CODE , 'USER' AS NAME FROM DUAL

SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION || (CASE WHEN B.PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ' Y' ELSE ' N' END) NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP , B.ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.PLANT_SITE_ID , T.ITEM_ID FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME T JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON S.SCM_SITE_ID = T.PLANT_SITE_ID JOIN SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS ON LS.COMPANY_ID = S.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID = T.DIVISION_ID AND LS.SITE_ID = S.SITE_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID = S.PLANT_ID AND LS.OPERATION_ID = T.OPERATION_ID AND LS.LINE_ID = T.LINE_ID AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND T.VALID_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY T.ITEM_ID , T.PLANT_SITE_ID UNION ALL SELECT PLANT_SITE_ID , ITEM_ID FROM SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA WHERE 1=1 AND VALID_YN ='Y' GROUP BY PLANT_SITE_ID , ITEM_ID ) B ON A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' ) A GROUP BY DIVISION_ID , CODE , NAME , OPERATION_GROUP , ITEM_ID ORDER BY UPPER(DIVISION_ID) , UPPER(CODE)

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,A.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION || (CASE WHEN B.PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL OR C.PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ' Y' ELSE ' N' END) AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.ITEM_ID , T.PLANT_SITE_ID FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME T JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON S.SCM_SITE_ID=T.PLANT_SITE_ID JOIN SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS ON LS.COMPANY_ID=S.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID=T.DIVISION_ID AND LS.SITE_ID=S.SITE_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID=S.PLANT_ID AND LS.OPERATION_ID=T.OPERATION_ID AND LS.LINE_ID=T.LINE_ID AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' WHERE T.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND T.ITEM_ID = @itemId AND T.VALID_YN='Y' GROUP BY T.ITEM_ID , T.PLANT_SITE_ID ) B ON A.SCM_SITE_ID=B.PLANT_SITE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PLANT_SITE_ID FROM SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND ITEM_ID = @itemId AND VALID_YN ='Y' GROUP BY PLANT_SITE_ID ) C ON A.SCM_SITE_ID= C.PLANT_SITE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY UPPER(A.DIVISION_ID), UPPER(CODE)

     , A.SEGMENT3  AS NAME
FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
AND    A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
AND    ( @divisionId IS NULL OR A.SEGMENT1 = @divisionId )
AND    ( @custGroup IS NULL OR @custGroup = ''
         OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SA
                      WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID  = A.SEGMENT1
                      AND   SA.PROJECT_CODE = A.SEGMENT2

SELECT DIVISION_ID
     , CODE
     , NAME
  FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                A.DIVISION_ID                     AS DIVISION_ID
              , A.END_CUSTOMER                    AS CODE
              , NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER)   AS NAME
           FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                         S.DIVISION_ID
                       , CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN I.PROJECT_CODE
                              ELSE S.END_CUSTOMER END AS END_CUSTOMER
                    FROM SCM_MST_SITE S
                    LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM I
                      ON S.DIVISION_ID = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND S.SCM_SITE_ID = I.SCM_SITE_ID
                   WHERE S.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                ) A
           LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
             ON A.DIVISION_ID   = D.SEGMENT1
            AND A.END_CUSTOMER  = D.SEGMENT2
            AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE   = 'END_CUSTOMER'
            AND D.VALID_YN      = 'Y'
          WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  IS NOT NULL
            AND A.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
            AND TRIM(A.END_CUSTOMER) IS NOT NULL
            AND A.END_CUSTOMER <> '-'
            AND ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                  OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
            AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT UNIT_ID
                                     FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
                                    WHERE USER_ID    = @sesUserId
                                      AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
                                      AND USE_YN     = 'Y' )
       )
 ORDER BY UPPER(DIVISION_ID), UPPER(NAME), UPPER(CODE)

SELECT DEPT_ID
     , CODE
     , NAME
FROM (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT C.DEPT_ID
         , A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE
         , NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
    FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON C.DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID
    LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1
      AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2
      AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
      AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
      AND ( NVL(@validYn, 'N') <> 'Y'
        OR A.VALID_YN = 'Y' )
      AND ( @deptId IS NULL
        OR @deptId = 'ALL'
        OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || A.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0 )
    UNION
    SELECT NULL AS DEPT_ID
         , SEGMENT2
         , SEGMENT3
    FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
    WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
      AND SEGMENT1 = '40'
      AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
      AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
      AND ( @deptId IS NULL
        OR @deptId = 'ALL' ) ))
GROUP BY DEPT_ID
     , CODE
     , NAME
ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)

SELECT DIVISION_ID
     , DEPT_ID
     , CODE
     , NAME
FROM (
  SELECT DIVISION_ID
       , DEPT_ID
       , CODE
       , NAME
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
         , C.DEPT_ID
         , A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE
         , NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
    FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON C.DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID
    LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1
      AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2
      AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
      AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
      AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
      AND A.PROJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT '40'
         , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200))
         , SEGMENT2
         , SEGMENT3
    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
    WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
      AND SEGMENT1 = '40'
      AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
      AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ))
GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
     , DEPT_ID
     , CODE
     , NAME
ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)

SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.END_CUSTOMER                  AS CODE
     , NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT SI9.DIVISION_ID, SI9.SCM_SITE_ID, SI9.DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI9) SI
    ON A.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = SI.SCM_SITE_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
    ON A.DIVISION_ID  = D.SEGMENT1
   AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2
   AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'END_CUSTOMER'
   AND D.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
 WHERE A.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
   AND TRIM(A.END_CUSTOMER) IS NOT NULL
   AND A.END_CUSTOMER <> '-'
   AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT UNIT_ID
                            FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
                           WHERE USER_ID    = @sesUserId
                             AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
                             AND USE_YN     = 'Y' )
   AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                    FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
                    JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                      ON G.USER_GR_ID = L.SEGMENT1
                   WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP'
                     AND L.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                     AND L.SEGMENT2 IN ('ALL','DMF0003')
                     AND G.USER_ID = @sesUserId
                     AND G.USE_YN  = 'Y' )
         OR SI.DEPT_ID IN ( SELECT L.SEGMENT3
                             FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
                            WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PM_TEAM_MAPPING'
                              AND L.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                              AND L.SEGMENT1 IN ( SELECT U.DEPT_ID
                                                    FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U
                                                   WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId )
                            UNION
                           SELECT U.DEPT_ID
                             FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U
                            WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId ) )
 ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)

SELECT DISTINCT CODE, NAME FROM (
  /* (1) END_CUSTOMER lookup axis - div 40 표기 원천 [E20260814-ENDCUST] */
  SELECT L.SEGMENT2 AS CODE, NVL(L.SEGMENT3, L.SEGMENT2) AS NAME
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
  WHERE  L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L.SEGMENT2 <> '-'
  AND    ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') = '-' OR L.SEGMENT1 = TRIM(@divisionId) )
  UNION ALL
  /* (2) div 40 : SITE_ITEM owner axis (AS-IS EndCustomerByDivision40) */
  SELECT A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE, NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
  JOIN   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON C.DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
         ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2
        AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  WHERE  A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND TRIM(@divisionId) = '40' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
  UNION ALL
  /* (3) div 81/82 : 조회조건과 동일 축 = SCM_MST_SITE.END_CUSTOMER (AS-IS BigFilter
         EndCustomerByDivision 의 비40 분기 원문과 동일) [E20260818-ENDCUST81] */
  SELECT S.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE, NVL(D.SEGMENT3, S.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE S
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
         ON D.SEGMENT1 = S.DIVISION_ID AND D.SEGMENT2 = S.END_CUSTOMER
        AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  WHERE  S.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL AND NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') <> '-'
  AND    S.DIVISION_ID = TRIM(@divisionId) AND TRIM(@divisionId) <> '40'
) ORDER BY UPPER(NAME)

SELECT *
  FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT A.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE , NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y' WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @deptId IS NULL OR @deptId = 'ALL' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SA WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND SA.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID AND INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || SA.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0 ) ) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT U.UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT G.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId ) AND A.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT  SEGMENT2                AS CODE      ,  NVL(SEGMENT3, SEGMENT2) AS NAME   FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  WHERE  SEGMENT1 IN ( SELECT U.UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT G.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId )    AND  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'    AND  VALID_YN    = 'Y'    AND  SEGMENT2   <> '-'    AND  SEGMENT1   <> '40'    AND  ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL'           OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || SEGMENT1 || ',') > 0 )    AND  ( @deptId IS NULL OR @deptId = 'ALL' )
       )
 ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)

SELECT
	DISTINCT A.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE ,
	NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
FROM
	SCM_MST_SITE A
LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON
	A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
	AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D ON
	A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1
	AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2
	AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
	AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
WHERE
	1 = 1
	AND ( @divisionId IS NULL
		OR @divisionId = 'ALL'
		OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
	AND ( @deptId IS NULL
		OR @deptId = 'ALL'
		OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || B.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0 )
	AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (
	SELECT
		U.UNIT_ID
	FROM
		SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
	WHERE
		U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
		AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
		AND ( U.USER_GR_ID = 'ADMIN'
			OR U.USER_GR_ID LIKE 'DM%' )
		AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId )
	AND A.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
	AND ( EXISTS (
	SELECT
		1
	FROM
		SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G9
	WHERE
		G9.USER_ID = @sesUserId
		AND G9.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT L9.SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L9 WHERE L9.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP' AND L9.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L9.SEGMENT2 IN ( 'ALL', 'DMF0003' ) )
		AND G9.USE_YN = 'Y' )
	OR B.DEPT_ID IN (
	SELECT
		L.SEGMENT3
	FROM
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
	WHERE
		L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PM_TEAM_MAPPING'
		AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND L.SEGMENT1 = (
		SELECT
			MAX(U.DEPT_ID)
		FROM
			SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U
		WHERE
			U.USER_ID = @sesUserId )
UNION
	SELECT
		U.DEPT_ID
	FROM
		SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U
	WHERE
		U.USER_ID = @sesUserId ) )
ORDER BY
	UPPER(CODE)
SELECT segment2 AS CODE ,segment3 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND SEGMENT1 = '40' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY UPPER(segment2) ASC

SELECT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE, '(' || A.FACTORY_ID || ')' || NVL(A.FACTORY_NAME, A.FACTORY_ID) AS NAME FROM SCM_FACTORY_M_SN A , ( SELECT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID FROM TH_UIS_USER_FACTORY_RELATE_SN A , TH_UIS_ROLE_FACTORY_RELATE_SN B WHERE A.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND A.ROLE_ID = B.ROLE_ID AND A.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID ) AA WHERE A.COMPANY_ID=AA.COMPANY_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID=AA.DIVISION_ID AND A.SITE_ID=AA.SITE_ID AND A.PLANT_ID=AA.PLANT_ID AND A.FACTORY_ID=AA.FACTORY_ID AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M_SN A INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M_SN B ON A.FACTORY_ID=B.FACTORY_ID AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.INSTANCE_ID = @instanceId ) C WHERE C.COMPANY_ID=A.COMPANY_ID AND C.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SITE_ID=A.SITE_ID AND C.PLANT_ID=A.PLANT_ID AND C.FACTORY_ID=A.FACTORY_ID ) AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) GROUP BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.FACTORY_NAME ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID

	     , A.USE_YN

)

SELECT CODE, NAME
FROM
(
	SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME
	FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A 
	WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2'
	AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'

SELECT CODE, NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ FROM (
  /* [E20260814-WSDIV → E20260819-FCSTTYPE6] 81 계열 + DM Planner(W/S)
     → SALES_TYPE_CODE2 ∪ SALES_TYPE_CODE2_ADD 6종 (2026-08-19 통합테스트 —

  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME
       , CASE LOOKUP_TYPE WHEN 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2' THEN DISPLAY_SEQ ELSE 100 + DISPLAY_SEQ END AS DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE IN ('SALES_TYPE_CODE2', 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2_ADD')
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
  AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                 WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') /* [E20261012-FCSTTYPEADM] 일반 그룹 겸직자는 일반 유형도 함께 받으므로 겹치는 코드는 여기서 제외(중복 방지) */ AND NOT ( SEGMENT1 IN (SELECT S.SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL S WHERE S.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE' AND S.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(S.ATTRIBUTE2, ' ') <> 'Y') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M A WHERE A.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND A.USER_GR_ID IN ('ADMIN', 'DM ADMIN', 'DM Planner', 'SCM PI Admin') AND TO_CHAR(A.USE_YN) = 'Y') )
  UNION ALL
  /* division 전달 + W/S 자격 아님 → SALES_TYPE_CODE 에서 전용플래그(ATTRIBUTE2='Y' — 실측 WS/WSF 2건 유일) 제외 = 12종 */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, ' ') <> 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') <> '-'
  AND    ( NOT ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                           WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') ) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M A WHERE A.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND A.USER_GR_ID IN ('ADMIN', 'DM ADMIN', 'DM Planner', 'SCM PI Admin') AND TO_CHAR(A.USE_YN) = 'Y') )
  UNION ALL
  /* division 미전달(메타 셀 콤보 = CODE->NAME 표시 매핑) → 전 코드 1행씩 (중복 없음) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ

  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') = '-'
) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ, UPPER(CODE)

SELECT DIVISION_ID

  SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID

    AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
    AND ( NVL(@validYn, 'N') <> 'Y'
      OR A.VALID_YN = 'Y' )
  UNION /* 40 룩업 */
  SELECT SEGMENT1
       , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))
       , SEGMENT2 AS CODE
       , SEGMENT3 AS NAME
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
    AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
    AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
    AND SEGMENT1 = '40'
  UNION ALL /* 판매 사이트 원장 - 아이템 원장의 부서마다 한 행 */
  SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
       , B.DEPT_ID
       , A.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE
       , NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
       , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
       , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
  WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
    AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
    AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1(+)
    AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2(+)
    AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'END_CUSTOMER'
    AND D.VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
    AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (
    SELECT U.UNIT_ID
    FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
    WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
      AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
      AND U.USER_GR_ID IN (
      SELECT G.USER_GR_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
      WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId
        AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' )
      AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId )
    AND A.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
    AND A.END_CUSTOMER <> '-'
    AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
  UNION ALL /* 비40 룩업 */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID
       , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS DEPT_ID
       , SEGMENT2 AS CODE
       , NVL(SEGMENT3, SEGMENT2) AS NAME
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE SEGMENT1 IN (
    SELECT U.UNIT_ID
    FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
    WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
      AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
      AND U.USER_GR_ID IN (
      SELECT G.USER_GR_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
      WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId
        AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' )
      AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId )
    AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
    AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
    AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
    AND SEGMENT1 <> '40' )
GROUP BY DIVISION_ID

--[E20260812-MKTFCSTEDITMEASURE-V2] AS-IS UP_FX 'MktFcstEditMeasure' 전분기 원문보존 변환 (82+@measure 지정분기 / 일반=INSERT_YN+VMI(@scmSiteId) / CUST_FCST / TMM(@projectCode+@sesUserId) — 상호배타 가드)
--* Sales Site의 VMI = Y인 Site 입력 시 VMI In Request 메저가 입력해야 함 (예시) SCM_SITE_ID = LGCEG_DE_MWA
--* Sales Site가 비축용 Site일 경우 MKT FCST[R+P], AS_In_Request[R+P] 메저 둘다 입력 가능해야 함 (예시) SCM_SITE_ID =  HQ05-82-AS
--* Sales Site가 고객향 Site일 경우 MKT FCST[R+P] 메저만 입력 가능해야 함   (예시) SCM_SITE_ID = 300MS 8ME SBS1_US_LAS
WITH WT_AS_FROM_SITE AS (
	--*[2026-09-15] POJ 비축향 SITE를 구분하기 위한 정보
  	SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(SEGMENT1) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS AS_YN
  	FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  	WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT'
  	AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  	AND   (NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') = '-' OR SEGMENT3 = TRIM(@divisionId))
  	AND    SEGMENT1 = @scmSiteId
) 
SELECT CODE, NAME FROM (
-- ══ 82 지정메저 분기 (원문 IF @PARAM1='82' AND ISNULL(@PARAM5,'')<>'') ══
SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, SEGMENT3 AS NAME, 0 AS DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MKT_FCST_MEASURE'
  AND SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
  AND SEGMENT2 = @measure
  AND NVL(@divisionId,'-') = '82' 
  --AND @measure IS NOT NULL    --*[20260814] 없어도 될 내용이라 제거
UNION ALL
-- ══ ELSE: TMM 제외 일반 MEASURE (원문 1:1 — VMI_YN = SCM_MST_SITE(@divisionId,@scmSiteId)) ══
SELECT L.SEGMENT2 AS CODE, L.SEGMENT3 AS NAME, L.DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
WHERE 1=1
  AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MKT_FCST_MEASURE'
  AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND NVL(TRIM(L.ATTRIBUTE2),'-') <> 'Y'  -- TMM Measure여부
  AND L.SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
  AND L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y'     -- INSERT_YN 여부
  --[C20201015-000200]
  AND ( ( NVL((SELECT S.VMI_YN FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId AND S.SCM_SITE_ID=@scmSiteId),'N') = 'N' AND L.ATTRIBUTE1 <> 'Y' )
     OR ( NVL((SELECT S.VMI_YN FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId AND S.SCM_SITE_ID=@scmSiteId),'N') = 'Y' ) )
  AND ( NVL(@divisionId,'-') <> '82' OR @measure IS NULL )
	  --*[2026.09.15] POJ 일반SITE 인 경우 MKT_FCST(R+P) 메저만 나오도록 처리
	  AND (SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(@scmSiteId,'-') = '-' THEN 'Y' WHEN AS_YN = 'N' AND L.SEGMENT2 = 'AS_In_Req' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END FROM WT_AS_FROM_SITE) = 'Y'
UNION ALL
-- ══ ELSE: CUST_FCST MEASURE (원문 1:1) ══
SELECT T.CODE, T.NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.CODE) + 900 AS DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CF.MEASURE AS CODE, ' └ ' || CF.MEASURE AS NAME
	  FROM DM_MST_CUSTOMER_FCST CF
	  WHERE CF.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND CF.MEASURE_GROUP = 'CUST_FCST'
		AND CF.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId
		AND CF.SCM_SITE_ID = @scmSiteId) T
WHERE ( NVL(@divisionId,'-') <> '82' OR @measure IS NULL )
UNION ALL
-- ══ ELSE: TMM Measure (원문 1:1 — TMM_MEASURE_ADMIN 게이트 TOP1=ROWNUM) ══
SELECT L.SEGMENT2, L.SEGMENT3, L.DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
INNER JOIN (SELECT VALID_YN, SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT4
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
			WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'TMM_MEASURE_ADMIN'
			  AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
			  AND SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
			  AND SEGMENT2 = @projectCode
			  AND SEGMENT4 = @sesUserId
			  AND ROWNUM = 1) T
  ON ( L.SEGMENT1 = T.SEGMENT1
   AND L.VALID_YN = T.VALID_YN
   AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MKT_FCST_MEASURE'
   AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND L.SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
   AND NVL(TRIM(L.ATTRIBUTE2),'-') = 'Y'
   AND L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y' )
WHERE ( NVL(@divisionId,'-') <> '82' OR @measure IS NULL )
) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT IA.PERIOD AS CODE
     , IA.PERIOD AS NAME
     , IA.PERIOD
  FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) IS NOT NULL
                    THEN MIN(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) || ':' || MAX(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
               END AS PERIOD
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
             , (SELECT XA.OFFSET_DAY
                     , REPLACE(XA.FROM_DATE, '-', '') AS FROM_KEY
                     , CASE WHEN INSTR(XA.FROM_DATE, '-') > 0
                            THEN REPLACE(XA.FROM_DATE, '-', '') || CHR(1)
                            ELSE XA.FROM_DATE
                       END AS FROM_LOW /* AS-IS 하이픈 날짜 입력 시 시작일 당일 제외 */
                     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(XA.FROM_DATE, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') + XA.OFFSET_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TO_KEY
                  FROM (SELECT NVL(TRIM(@fromDate), TO_CHAR(FN_MULTY_TIME(TRIM(@timeZone)), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS FROM_DATE
                             , CASE WHEN NVL(TO_NUMBER(TRIM(@offsetDay)), 0) = 0 THEN 6
                                    ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(@offsetDay))
                               END AS OFFSET_DAY /* AS-IS INT 인자 빈값·0 → 6 */
                          FROM DUAL) XA) B
         WHERE (   (    B.OFFSET_DAY < 0
                    AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= B.FROM_KEY
                    AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= B.TO_KEY)
                OR (    B.OFFSET_DAY > 0
                    AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= B.FROM_LOW
                    AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= B.TO_KEY))) IA

     , A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
     , A.SCM_SITE_ID AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , A.CITY AS CITY
     , A.COUNTRY AS COUNTRY
     , A.PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID
     , A.OPERATION_GROUP AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , D.DEPT_ID AS DEPT_ID
     , D.DEPT_NAME_KO AS DEPT_NAME_KO
     , T.DEPT_ID AS TEAM_ID
     , T.DEPT_NAME_KO AS TEAM_NAME_KO
     , SC.SOLDTO_CODE AS SOLDTO_CODE
     , C.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION AS SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
     , SC.SHIPTO_CODE AS SHIPTO_CODE
     , C.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION AS SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
     , A.VMI_YN AS VMI_YN
     , A.VALID_YN AS VALID_YN
     , A.NEW_YN AS NEW_YN
     , A.SITE_HRCY_ID AS SITE_HRCY_ID
     , A.OSP_YN AS OSP_YN
     , A.SHIP_FROZEN AS SHIP_FROZEN
     , A.PROD_FROZEN AS PROD_FROZEN
     , A.END_CUSTOMER AS END_CUSTOMER
     , A.FP_PLAN_PERIOD AS FP_PLAN_PERIOD
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
     , SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_REP_V IA
     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO T
     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D
     , SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER SC
     , SCM_MST_CUSTOMER C
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = IA.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = IA.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
   AND IA.DEPT_ID = T.DEPT_ID(+)
   AND T.UPPER_DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID(+)
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = SC.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = SC.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
   AND SC.REP_YN(+) = 'Y'
   AND SC.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND SC.SOLDTO_CODE = C.SOLDTO_CODE(+)
   AND SC.SHIPTO_CODE = C.SHIPTO_CODE(+)
   AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
   AND ( @divisionId = 'ALL'
         OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
   AND ( @scmSiteId = 'ALL'
         OR INSTR(',' || @scmSiteId || ',', ',' || A.SCM_SITE_ID || ',') > 0 )
 ORDER BY UPPER(A.SCM_SITE_ID)

SELECT DISTINCT B.DEPT_ID AS CODE
     , B.DEPT_NAME_KO AS NAME
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
     , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C
     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
   AND C.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
   AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
   AND ( @divisionId = 'ALL'
         OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
 ORDER BY UPPER(NAME)
     , UPPER(CODE)

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE
     , SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE
 ORDER BY UPPER(SCM_SITE_ID)

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE
     , SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE
 WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND ( @divisionId = 'ALL'
         OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
 ORDER BY UPPER(SCM_SITE_ID)
SELECT CODE , NAME FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SCM0001_PLANT_SITE_BY_END_CUST(@divisionId, @deptId, @endCustomer))
SELECT CODE , NAME FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SCM0001_TEAM_BY_DIVISION(@divisionId))

SELECT DISTINCT D.DEPT_ID AS CODE , CASE WHEN ( NVL(( SELECT MAX(U.LANG_CD) FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId ), 'KO') ) = 'EN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_EN WHEN ( NVL(( SELECT MAX(U.LANG_CD) FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId ), 'KO') ) = 'CN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_CN ELSE D.DEPT_NAME_KO END AS NAME , D.DEPT_NAME_KO , D.DEPT_NAME_EN , D.DEPT_NAME_CN FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U ON F.ATTRIBUTE6 = U.USER_ID JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || F.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)

SELECT MIN(YYYYMM) AS MIN_YYYYMM
     , MAX(YYYYMM) AS MAX_YYYYMM
  FROM SCP_ANL_LONG_TERM_STOCK

SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS KPI_ID , A.SEGMENT2 AS KPI_NM , A.SEGMENT3 AS DIVISION_ID , A.SEGMENT4 AS DEPT_ID , A.DISPLAY_SEQ FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE='SCM_KPI_GOAL' AND A.VALID_YN='Y' ORDER BY UPPER(A.SEGMENT1), UPPER(A.SEGMENT3), A.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT HORIZON_START_DATE ,HORIZON_END_DATE ,PLAN_CYCLE ,(TRUNC(TO_DATE(HORIZON_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'IW') - TRUNC(TO_DATE(PLAN_NAME, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'IW')) / 7 AS DIFF_WEEK FROM SCM_MST_PLAN WHERE 1 = 1 AND PLAN_NAME = @planName AND DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND PLAN_CYCLE = 'WEEKLY'

SELECT B.SEGMENT1 AS AUTH, B.SEGMENT4 AS MEASURE, ATTRIBUTE1 AS EDIT_DAYS, ATTRIBUTE2 AS FROM_TIME, ATTRIBUTE3 AS TO_TIME, ATTRIBUTE4 AS LIMIT_AUTH FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.SEGMENT2 = @segment2 AND B.SEGMENT3 = @segment3 AND B.SEGMENT1 = @segment1 AND (B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'ALL' OR B.ATTRIBUTE1 IN (SELECT DAYOFWEEK FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))) AND TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI:SS'), 1, 5), ':', '')) BETWEEN TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE2) AND TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3)

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , B.CODE , B.NAME FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY A , ( SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID , IA.CODE , IA.NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY IA.DIVISION_ID , IA.CODE ORDER BY IA.NAME DESC ) AS RN FROM ( SELECT C.DIVISION_ID , C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS CODE , CASE WHEN E.FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || D.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || D.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END AS NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V C , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M D , SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN E WHERE C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AND C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = E.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD (+) AND C.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID (+) GROUP BY C.DIVISION_ID , C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , D.WEEK_NAME , E.FP_TARGET_YN ) IA ) B WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.CODE AND B.RN = 1 GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , B.CODE , B.NAME ORDER BY UPPER(NAME) DESC
SELECT LEVEL AS CODE , LEVEL AS NAME FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_NUMBER(@maxNumber)
SELECT DISTINCT T.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID AS CODE ,T.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SETUP_MATRIX_SN T ORDER BY UPPER(T.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID)

SELECT DISTINCT T.FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID AS CODE ,T.FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SETUP_MATRIX_SN T WHERE (@divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || T.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || T.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@operationId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationId || ',', ',' || T.OPERATION_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY UPPER(T.FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID)

SELECT DISTINCT T.OPERATION_ID AS CODE ,O.OPERATION_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SETUP_MATRIX_SN T JOIN SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN O ON T.COMPANY_ID = O.COMPANY_ID AND T.DIVISION_ID = O.DIVISION_ID AND T.SITE_ID = O.SITE_ID AND T.OPERATION_ID = O.OPERATION_ID WHERE (@divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || T.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || T.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY UPPER(T.OPERATION_ID)

SELECT DISTINCT T.PLANT_ID AS CODE ,P.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SETUP_MATRIX_SN T JOIN SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN P ON T.COMPANY_ID = P.COMPANY_ID AND T.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID AND T.SITE_ID = P.SITE_ID AND T.PLANT_ID = P.PLANT_ID WHERE (@divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || T.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND T.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A WHERE USER_GR_ID = @__GROUP__ AND USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'P' AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || UPPR_UNIT_ID || ',') > 0 ) ) ORDER BY UPPER(T.PLANT_ID)

SELECT DISTINCT T.SETUP_CONDITION_ID AS CODE ,T.SETUP_CONDITION_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SETUP_MATRIX_SN T WHERE (@divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || T.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || T.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@operationId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationId || ',', ',' || T.OPERATION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@fromItemSetupGroupId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @fromItemSetupGroupId || ',', ',' || T.FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@toItemSetupGroupId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @toItemSetupGroupId || ',', ',' || T.TO_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY UPPER(T.SETUP_CONDITION_ID)

SELECT DISTINCT T.TO_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID AS CODE ,T.TO_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SETUP_MATRIX_SN T WHERE (@divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || T.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || T.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@operationId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationId || ',', ',' || T.OPERATION_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY UPPER(T.TO_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID)

SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE , CASE WHEN SEGMENT1 = '1D+' THEN TO_CHAR((SYSDATE + (TO_NUMBER(SEGMENT2))), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHEN SEGMENT1 = '2D-' THEN TO_CHAR((SYSDATE + (TO_NUMBER(SEGMENT2) * -1)), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END AS VALUE , SEGMENT2 AS Diff_VALUE FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIPMENT_PERIOD_DAY' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY UPPER(SEGMENT1)

SELECT B.SEGMENT1 CODE ,B.SEGMENT2 NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SOLD_TO_CUST_REPORT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY UPPER(B.SEGMENT1)

SELECT USER_ID AS CODE
     , USER_NM AS NAME
  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M
 WHERE ( @userName IS NULL
      OR USER_ID LIKE '%' || @userName || '%'
      OR USER_NM LIKE '%' || @userName || '%'
      OR USER_ENG_NM LIKE '%' || @userName || '%' )
 ORDER BY UPPER(USER_ID)

SELECT *
  FROM (
SELECT 'ALL' AS CODE , 'ALL' AS NAME , 0 AS SORT_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME , 1 AS SORT_NO FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND (@pPlantSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || SUBSTR(@pPlantSiteId,1,4) || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
       )
 ORDER BY SORT_NO
        , UPPER(CODE)

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID AS CODE , A.DIVISION_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION A WHERE A.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE' AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT U.UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND U.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT G.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AND ( NVL(TRIM(@mnuId), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR U.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT M.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M M WHERE M.MNU_ID = @mnuId AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' ) ) ) AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE1 ORDER BY UPPER(A.ATTRIBUTE1)

SELECT USER_ID AS CODE
     , USER_NM AS NAME
  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M
 WHERE ( @userName IS NULL
      OR USER_ID LIKE '%' || @userName || '%'
      OR USER_NM LIKE '%' || @userName || '%'
      OR USER_ENG_NM LIKE '%' || @userName || '%' )
 ORDER BY UPPER(USER_ID)

SELECT DISTINCT U.USER_ID AS CODE , U.USER_NM AS NAME , U.USER_ENG_NM , U.DEPT_ID , CASE WHEN @sesLangCd = 'KO' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_KO        WHEN @sesLangCd = 'EN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_EN        WHEN @sesLangCd = 'CN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_CN        ELSE '-' END AS DEPT_NM FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U, SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D, SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID (+)   AND G.USER_ID = U.USER_ID   AND G.USER_GR_ID IN ('SSP Planner', 'ADMIN', 'SCM PI Admin')   AND NVL(G.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'   AND NVL(U.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'   AND ( @userName IS NULL      OR UPPER(U.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(@userName) || '%'      OR UPPER(U.USER_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(@userName) || '%'      OR UPPER(U.USER_ENG_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(@userName) || '%' ) ORDER BY UPPER(U.USER_ID)
SELECT TRANSPORT_MODE|| ':' || BOD_ID|| ':' || TO_CHAR(ROUTE_ID)|| ':' || TO_CHAR(LT_TOTAL) CODE , TRANSPORT_MODE NAME FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND FROM_SITE = @fromSite
SELECT TRANSPORT_MODE|| ':' || BOD_ID|| ':' || TO_CHAR(ROUTE_ID)|| ':' || TO_CHAR(LT_TOTAL) CODE , TRANSPORT_MODE NAME FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND FROM_SITE = @fromSite
SELECT DISTINCT SSP_INCOTERMS AS CODE, SSP_INCOTERMS AS NAME FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND FROM_SITE = @fromSite AND TO_SITE = @toSite ORDER BY UPPER(SSP_INCOTERMS)

SELECT *
  FROM (
SELECT '-' AS CODE , '-' AS NAME FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND ITEM_ID = @itemId AND SCM_SITE_ID = @scmSiteId ) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PROJECT_CODE AS CODE , PROJECT_CODE AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND ITEM_ID = @itemId AND SCM_SITE_ID = @scmSiteId
       )
 ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)

SELECT DISTINCT TT.CODE, TT.NAME FROM ( SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND ITEM_ID = @itemId UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND OSP_YN = 'Y' AND DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) TT ORDER BY UPPER(TT.NAME)

SELECT TRANSPORT_MODE|| ':' || BOD_ID|| ':' || TO_CHAR(ROUTE_ID)|| ':' || TO_CHAR(LT_TOTAL) CODE , TRANSPORT_MODE AS NAME FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND FROM_SITE = @fromSite AND TO_SITE = @toSite AND SSP_INCOTERMS = @incoterms ORDER BY PRIORITY

SELECT CASE WHEN SYSDATE>=TO_DATE(SEGMENT2, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AND SYSDATE<=TO_DATE(SEGMENT3, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BLOCK_YN, SEGMENT2 || ' ~ ' || SEGMENT3 AS PERIOD FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE='FUNCTION_BLOCK' AND SEGMENT1=@segment1 AND VALID_YN='Y'
SELECT DISTINCT L.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , L.SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_ORG_NAME_DEPT_LIST' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A WHERE USER_GR_ID LIKE '%' || @__GROUP__ || '%' AND USER_ID LIKE '%' || @sesUserId || '%' AND UNIT_TP_CD = ( CASE WHEN @__GROUP__ = 'JV Planner' THEN 'J' ELSE 'D' END ))

SELECT B.SEGMENT1 CODE, B.SEGMENT2 NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIPMENT_RESULT_TYPE' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, T1.SEGMENT2 NAME
     FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1
    WHERE  1=1
      AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SYSTEM'
      AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'
 ORDER BY  T1.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || @PARAM1 || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME ,A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT BUCKET AS CODE, BUCKET AS NAME FROM (SELECT (NVL(SUN,0)||NVL(MON,0)||NVL(TUE,0)||NVL(WED,0)||NVL(THU,0)||NVL(FRI,0)||NVL(SAT,0)) AS BUCKET FROM (SELECT YYYYMMDD, CASE WHEN BUCKET_PER = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BUCKET_PER FROM SCM_MGR.DM_MST_BUCKET_CONVERSION WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND SCM_SITE_ID = @scmSiteId AND INCOTERMS = @incoterms) A PIVOT (MAX(BUCKET_PER) FOR YYYYMMDD IN ('SUN' AS SUN, 'MON' AS MON, 'TUE' AS TUE, 'WED' AS WED, 'THU' AS THU, 'FRI' AS FRI, 'SAT' AS SAT)) PVT)

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , 'S' AS OSP_YN , '' AS OPERATION_GROUP , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0

SELECT *
  FROM (
--[E20260812-SALESCOMPANY-V2] AS-IS UP_FX 'SalesCompany' IF/ELSE 2분기 원문보존 변환 (가드=@itemId 빈값 상호배타. DIVISION_ID 컬럼=TO-BE 확장 유지)
SELECT DISTINCT
	   S.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
	 , S.COMPANY_ID AS CODE
	 , S.COMPANY_ID AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
WHERE  SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
AND    (@plantId IS NULL OR @plantId='' OR PLANT_ID=@plantId)
AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
AND    ( @itemId IS NULL OR @itemId = '' )  -- 원문 IF ( @Param4 = '' ) 직역
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
	   S.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
	 , COMPANY_ID AS CODE
	 , COMPANY_ID AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
WHERE  1 = 1
AND    SITE_TYPE = 'CORP'
AND    (@plantId IS NULL OR @plantId='' OR PLANT_ID=@plantId)
AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
AND    ( @itemId IS NULL OR @itemId = '' )
-- ══ ELSE 분기 (@Param4 존재 — ITEM 기반) — 원문 1:1 ══
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
	   S.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
	 , S.COMPANY_ID AS CODE
	 , S.COMPANY_ID AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.COMPANY_ID, I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP --[C20200608-000328] SalesCompany 콤보는 Item Master의 Company ID, Operation Group 기준으로 조회
			FROM   SCM_MST_PROJECT_ITEM SI
			INNER JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
			ON     SI.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
			WHERE  1=1 --[C20200818-000264] Project_Item Master Valid 조건 제외, Item Master Valid 조건 추가
			AND    I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			AND    (I.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' OR I.DIVISION_ID = '82')
			AND    I.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL --[C20200626-000172]
			AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR SI.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
			AND    (@projectCode IS NULL OR @projectCode='' OR SI.PROJECT_CODE=@projectCode)
			AND    (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId='' OR SI.ITEM_ID=@itemId)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.COMPANY_ID, I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
			FROM   SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
			WHERE  1=1
			AND    I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			AND    I.DIVISION_ID IN ('40')
			AND    I.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL
			AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR I.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
			AND    (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId='' OR I.ITEM_ID=@itemId)
			) SS
ON  S.DIVISION_ID = SS.DIVISION_ID
AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = NVL(SS.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP, S.OPERATION_GROUP)
AND S.COMPANY_ID = SS.COMPANY_ID
WHERE  1 = 1
AND    SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
--AND    OSP_YN    <> 'Y'
AND    (@plantId IS NULL OR @plantId='' OR PLANT_ID=@plantId)
AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
AND    @itemId IS NOT NULL  -- 원문 ELSE — ''=NULL 방언(<>'' 직역은 항상 UNKNOWN)
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
	   S.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
	 , COMPANY_ID AS CODE
	 , COMPANY_ID AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
WHERE  1 = 1
AND    SITE_TYPE = 'CORP'
AND    (@plantId IS NULL OR @plantId='' OR PLANT_ID=@plantId)
AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
AND    @itemId IS NOT NULL
       )
 ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)
        , UPPER(NAME)

SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_UI_EDITABLE_DIVISION'
  AND SEGMENT1 = 'DMF0020'
  AND ATTRIBUTE1 = 'Y'
  AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY UPPER(SEGMENT2)

SELECT CODE, NAME, DIVISION_ID
  FROM (
    SELECT B.SEGMENT1 AS CODE
         , B.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
         , B.SEGMENT3 AS DIVISION_ID
         , B.DISPLAY_SEQ
         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.SEGMENT1
               ORDER BY CASE WHEN B.SEGMENT3 = @divisionId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, B.DISPLAY_SEQ) AS RN
      FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
     WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_PLAN_ITEM_ID'
       AND B.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
       AND (B.SEGMENT3 = @divisionId OR B.SEGMENT3 = SUBSTR(@divisionId, 1, 2))
  )
 WHERE RN = 1
 ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ, UPPER(CODE)

SELECT *
  FROM (

SELECT DISTINCT

	 , CASE WHEN OSP_YN = 'Y' THEN LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID ELSE PLANT_ID END AS CODE
	 , CASE WHEN OSP_YN = 'Y' THEN LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID ELSE PLANT_ID END AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
WHERE  1 = 1
AND    SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
--AND    OSP_YN    <> 'Y'
AND    (@companyId IS NULL OR @companyId='' OR S.COMPANY_ID=@companyId)
AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
AND    ( @itemId IS NULL OR @itemId = '' )  -- 원문 IF ISNULL(@Param4,'')='' 직역

SELECT DISTINCT
	   S.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
	 , PLANT_ID AS CODE
	 , PLANT_ID AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
WHERE  1 = 1
AND    SITE_TYPE = 'CORP'
AND    (@companyId IS NULL OR @companyId='' OR S.COMPANY_ID=@companyId)
AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
AND    ( @itemId IS NULL OR @itemId = '' )  -- 원문 IF ISNULL(@Param4,'')='' 직역
-- ══ ELSE 분기 (@Param4 존재 — ITEM 기반) — 원문 1:1 ══
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
	   S.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
	 , CASE WHEN OSP_YN = 'Y' THEN LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID ELSE PLANT_ID END AS CODE
	 , CASE WHEN OSP_YN = 'Y' THEN LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID ELSE PLANT_ID END AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.COMPANY_ID, I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP --[C20200608-000328] SalesCompany 콤보는 Item Master의 Company ID, Operation Group 기준으로 조회
			FROM   SCM_MST_PROJECT_ITEM SI
			INNER JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
			ON     SI.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
			--AND    SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IS NOT NULL --[C20200608-000328]
			WHERE  1=1 --si.valid_yn = 'Y' --[C20200818-000264] Project_Item Master Valid 조건 제외, Item Master Valid 조건 추가
			AND    I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			AND    (I.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' OR I.DIVISION_ID = '82')
			AND    I.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL --[C20200626-000172] SalesCompany, SalesPlant 에 Item Type is not null 조건 추가
			AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR SI.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
			AND    (@projectCode IS NULL OR @projectCode='' OR SI.PROJECT_CODE=@projectCode)
			AND    (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId='' OR SI.ITEM_ID=@itemId)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.COMPANY_ID, I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP --[C20200608-000328]
			FROM   SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
			WHERE  1=1
			AND    I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' --[C20200818-000264]
			AND    I.DIVISION_ID IN ('40')
			AND    I.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL --[C20200626-000172]
			AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR I.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
			AND    (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId='' OR I.ITEM_ID=@itemId)
			) SS
ON  S.DIVISION_ID = SS.DIVISION_ID
AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = NVL(SS.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP, S.OPERATION_GROUP)
AND S.COMPANY_ID = SS.COMPANY_ID --[C20200608-000328] SalesPlant 콤보는 Item Master의 Company ID, Operation Group 기준으로 조회
WHERE  1 = 1
AND    SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
--AND    OSP_YN    <> 'Y'
AND    (@companyId IS NULL OR @companyId='' OR S.COMPANY_ID=@companyId)
AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
AND    @itemId IS NOT NULL  -- 원문 ELSE(ISNULL(@Param4,'')<>'') Oracle 등가 — ''=NULL 방언이라 <>'' 직역은 항상 UNKNOWN
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
	   S.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
	 , PLANT_ID AS CODE
	 , PLANT_ID AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
WHERE  1 = 1
AND    SITE_TYPE = 'CORP'
AND    (@companyId IS NULL OR @companyId='' OR S.COMPANY_ID=@companyId)
AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
AND    @itemId IS NOT NULL  -- 원문 ELSE(ISNULL(@Param4,'')<>'') Oracle 등가 — ''=NULL 방언이라 <>'' 직역은 항상 UNKNOWN
       )
 ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)
        , UPPER(NAME)

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT DIVISION_CODE
, DIVISION_CODE || ' ' || DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME
, TEAM_CODE
, TEAM_NAME
, END_CUSTOMER_CODE
, END_CUSTOMER_NAME
, SALES_SITE_CODE
, SALES_SITE_NAME
, SRC_TYPE
, CODE
, NAME
FROM ( SELECT X1.*
, SALES_SITE_CODE AS CODE
, SALES_SITE_NAME AS NAME
FROM ( SELECT V.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_CODE
, V.DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME
, X.DEPT_ID AS TEAM_CODE
, ( SELECT CASE @sesLangCd WHEN 'EN' THEN D9.DEPT_NAME_EN
WHEN 'CN' THEN D9.DEPT_NAME_CN
ELSE D9.DEPT_NAME_KO END
FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D9
WHERE D9.DEPT_ID = X.DEPT_ID ) AS TEAM_NAME
, X.END_CUSTOMER AS END_CUSTOMER_CODE
, NVL( ( SELECT MIN(L9.SEGMENT3)
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L9
WHERE L9.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
AND L9.VALID_YN = 'Y'
AND L9.SEGMENT1 = X.DIVISION_ID
AND L9.SEGMENT2 = X.END_CUSTOMER )
, X.END_CUSTOMER ) AS END_CUSTOMER_NAME
, X.SALES_SITE AS SALES_SITE_CODE
, X.SALES_SITE_NAME AS SALES_SITE_NAME
, X.SRC_TYPE
, X.SORT_ORDER
FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V
JOIN (
SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
, B.DEPT_ID AS DEPT_ID
, CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN B.PROJECT_CODE
ELSE A.END_CUSTOMER END AS END_CUSTOMER

, NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(A.SITE_DESCRIPTION), '-'), A.SCM_SITE_ID) AS SALES_SITE_NAME
, 'SITE' AS SRC_TYPE
, 2 AS SORT_ORDER
FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
AND NVL(A.OPERATION_GROUP, ' ') <> 'W'

, NULL
, NULL
, L.SEGMENT1
, L.SEGMENT2
, 'AS'
, 1
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT'
AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
) X
ON V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
WHERE V.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE'
AND V.VALID_YN = 'Y'
AND V.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT UNIT_ID
FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId
AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
AND USE_YN = 'Y' )
AND ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || V.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
AND ( NVL(TRIM(@deptId), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
OR X.SRC_TYPE = 'AS'
OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || X.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0 )
AND ( NVL(TRIM(@endCustomer), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
OR X.SRC_TYPE = 'AS'
OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || X.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0 )
ORDER BY V.DIVISION_ID, X.SORT_ORDER, X.DEPT_ID, X.END_CUSTOMER, X.SALES_SITE
) X1
) X3
) ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)

  FROM (

         , 2 AS SORT_ORDER
    FROM SCM_MST_SITE A

        OR A.VALID_YN = 'Y' )
      AND NVL(A.OPERATION_GROUP, ' ') <> 'W'
      AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
      AND (NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
        OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)
      AND (NVL(TRIM(@endCustomer), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
        OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || A.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0)
      AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (
      SELECT UNIT_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
      WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId
        AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
        AND USE_YN = 'Y')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT A.SCM_SITE_ID
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
         , 2
    FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
    LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
    WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
      AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
      AND ( NVL(@validYn, 'N') <> 'Y'
        OR A.VALID_YN = 'Y' )
      AND NVL(A.OPERATION_GROUP, ' ') <> 'W'
      AND (NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
        OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',40,') > 0)
      AND (NVL(TRIM(@deptId), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
        OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || B.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0)
      AND (NVL(TRIM(@endCustomer), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
        OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || B.PROJECT_CODE || ',') > 0)
      AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (
      SELECT UNIT_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
      WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId
        AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
        AND USE_YN = 'Y')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT L.SEGMENT1
         , B.SITE_DESCRIPTION
         , 1
    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON L.SEGMENT3 = B.DIVISION_ID

        OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || L.SEGMENT3 || ',') > 0) )
  GROUP BY CODE

SELECT CODE
     , NAME
  FROM ( SELECT A.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AS CODE
              , A.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AS NAME
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
              , ( SELECT IB.SCM_SITE_ID
                       , IB.PROJECT_CODE
                       , IB.DEPT_ID
                    FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM     IB
                       , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO ID
                   WHERE IB.DEPT_ID     = ID.DEPT_ID
                     AND IB.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId ) IA
          WHERE A.SCM_SITE_ID = IA.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND A.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId
            AND NVL(@divisionId, '~') = '40'
            AND ( NVL(@deptId, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                  OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || IA.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0 )
            AND ( NVL(@endCustomer, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                  OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || IA.PROJECT_CODE || ',') > 0 )
          GROUP BY A.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
         UNION ALL
         /* 2026-10-09 POJ 원본 — 아이템 · 부서 내부 연결로 아이템 없는 사이트 누락
           SELECT D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AS CODE
                , D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AS NAME
             FROM SCM_MST_SITE          D
                , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM     DA
                , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO E
            WHERE DA.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
              AND DA.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
              AND DA.DEPT_ID     = E.DEPT_ID
              AND D.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId
              AND NVL(@divisionId, '~') <> '40'
              AND D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
              AND ( NVL(@deptId, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                    OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || E.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0 )
              AND ( NVL(@endCustomer, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                    OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || D.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0 )
         */
         /* 2026-10-09 POJ 비40 사이트 기준(AS-IS 와 같음), 팀 선택 시에만 아이템 부서 확인 (START) */
         SELECT D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AS CODE
              , D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AS NAME
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE D
          WHERE D.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId
            AND NVL(@divisionId, '~') <> '40'
            AND D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
            AND ( NVL(@deptId, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                  OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM     SA
                                   , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO SB
                               WHERE SB.DEPT_ID     = SA.DEPT_ID
                                 AND SA.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                                 AND SA.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
                                 AND INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || SB.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0 ) )
            AND ( NVL(@endCustomer, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                  OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || D.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0 )
         /* 2026-10-09 POJ 비40 사이트 기준(AS-IS 와 같음), 팀 선택 시에만 아이템 부서 확인 (END) */
          GROUP BY D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER ) XA
 ORDER BY UPPER(CODE)
